name: Araby
summary: Araby is the desert region in which the nameless city lies remote, crumbling and inarticulate beneath ancient sands.
description: Araby is the desert in which the nameless city lies remote, crumbling and inarticulate, its low walls nearly hidden by the sands of uncounted ages.

sources.quote: Remote in the desert of Araby lies the nameless city, crumbling and inarticulate, its low walls nearly hidden by the sands of uncounted ages.

facts: The nameless city lies remote in the desert of Araby.

needsReview.reason: 'Araby' is a poetic name that may correspond to the real-world Arabia (used elsewhere in the mythos as the setting for Irem), but no window explicitly equates the two.
